user.title: Bitpanda Setup
user.description: Enter your Bitpanda API key. You can create one in your [Bitpanda account settings]({api_key_url}).

currency.title: Select Currency
currency.description:
Select the currency used for all prices and wallet values.

⚠️ This setting cannot be changed later. To use a different currency, you will need to remove and re-add the integration.

After setup, you can configure wallets and price tracking via the integration options.

price_tracker.title: Price Tracker
price_tracker.description: Add or remove assets to track their live prices.

crypto_wallets.title: Crypto Wallets
crypto_wallets.description: Add or remove crypto wallets to monitor their current value.

fiat_wallets.title: Fiat Wallets
fiat_wallets.description: Add or remove fiat wallets to monitor their current value.

metal_wallets.title: Metal Wallets
metal_wallets.description: Add or remove metal wallets to monitor their current value.

index_wallets.title: Index Wallets
index_wallets.description: Add or remove index wallets to monitor their current value.
